distribution_obligations: include Apache-2.0 attribution for Popcorn, FissionVM selection, and Mbed TLS
include Emscripten, LLVM, Binaryen, and bundled-tool notices
preserve REUSE and file-level notices when redistributing FissionVM source

risks.finding: FissionVM is not registered as a GitHub fork and its qualified commit is not present in atomvm/AtomVM.
risks.mitigation: Treat the exact FissionVM commit as an independent maintained input; review upstream AtomVM changes manually before every pin update.
risks.stop_condition: No accountable maintainer or no rebuildable immutable source remains available.

risks.finding: LocalLiveView packages AtomVM assets without embedding the FissionVM source commit or a signed provenance statement.
risks.mitigation: Use the packaged asset only as a Phase 2 inspection oracle; Phase 3 must rebuild from the selected lock and compare behavior and structure.
risks.stop_condition: A clean rebuild cannot account for the required runtime behavior or license notices.

risks.finding: The packaged runtime imports fixed shared memory and atomic instructions, requiring browser cross-origin isolation.
risks.mitigation: Qualify COOP/COEP delivery in the Phoenix profile and provide an explicit unsupported/fallback result when isolation is absent.
risks.stop_condition: The selected browser profile cannot safely provide SharedArrayBuffer isolation.

update_triggers: Popcorn, LocalLiveView, FissionVM, AtomVM, Mbed TLS, or Emscripten release or security advisory
movement or deletion of the upstream swm branch or any selected artifact
change to Popcorn patch directories, release Dockerfiles, pnpm lock, or runtime build script
new divergence from AtomVM or loss of FissionVM maintenance
change in Wasm threads, atomics, shared-memory, CSP, COOP, or COEP browser requirements
hash, license, notice, vulnerability, or clean-acquisition mismatch
